dashboard.label: IDSentinel — Identity Threat Detection
dashboard.description: Scenario 10 — Real-time SOC visibility across all four identity threat detections. Entra ID sign-in and audit logs ingested via Graph API.

search.query: index="idsentinel_identity" sourcetype="azure:monitor:aad:signin" earliest=-24h (status.errorCode=500121 OR status.errorCode=500082 OR match(lower(mfaDetail.authDetail),"denied")) | stats count

index="idsentinel_identity" sourcetype="azure:monitor:aad:audit" earliest=-24h (match(lower(activityDisplayName),"add member to role") OR match(lower(activityDisplayName),"pim activation")) result=success loggedByService=PIM | stats count

index="idsentinel_identity" sourcetype="azure:monitor:aad:signin" earliest=-24h clientAppUsed IN ("Exchange ActiveSync","IMAP","MAPI","POP3","SMTP","Other clients","Authenticated SMTP","Legacy Authentication Clients") | stats count
index="idsentinel_identity" sourcetype="azure:monitor:aad:signin" earliest=-24h riskLevelAggregated IN ("medium","high") | stats count

chart.title: Sign-in Volume — Last 24 Hours (by Risk Level)

search.query: index="idsentinel_identity" sourcetype="azure:monitor:aad:signin" earliest=-24h | eval risk_bucket = case( riskLevelAggregated="high", "High Risk", riskLevelAggregated="medium", "Medium Risk", riskLevelAggregated="low", "Low Risk", true(), "None" ) | timechart span=30m count BY risk_bucket

index="idsentinel_identity" sourcetype="azure:monitor:aad:signin" earliest=-60m (status.errorCode=500121 OR status.errorCode=500082 OR match(lower(mfaDetail.authDetail),"denied")) authenticationRequirement=multiFactorAuthentication | stats count BY userPrincipalName | sort -count | head 10
index="idsentinel_identity" sourcetype="azure:monitor:aad:signin" earliest=-6h | iplocation ipAddress | geostats latfield=lat longfield=lon count BY riskLevelAggregated

chart.title: D-03: PIM Activations — Last 7 Days (After-Hours Highlighted)

search.query: index="idsentinel_identity" sourcetype="azure:monitor:aad:audit" earliest=-7d (match(lower(activityDisplayName),"add member to role") OR match(lower(activityDisplayName),"pim activation")) result=success loggedByService=PIM | eval event_time_utc = strptime(activityDateTime, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ") | eval local_epoch = event_time_utc + (-5 * 3600) | eval local_hour = tonumber(strftime(local_epoch, "%H")) | eval hours_bucket = if(local_hour >= 22 OR local_hour < 6, "After Hours (10pm-6am)", "Business Hours") | timechart span=6h count BY hours_bucket

chart.title: D-04: Legacy Auth Attempts — Last 7 Days (Blocked vs Not Blocked)

search.query: index="idsentinel_identity" sourcetype="azure:monitor:aad:signin" earliest=-7d clientAppUsed IN ("Exchange ActiveSync","IMAP","MAPI","POP3","SMTP","Other clients","Authenticated SMTP","Legacy Authentication Clients") | eval ca_status = if(conditionalAccessStatus="failure","Blocked by CA Policy","Not Blocked") | timechart span=12h count BY ca_status

table.title: Top Source IPs — Legacy Auth Attempts (Last 24hr)

search.query: index="idsentinel_identity" sourcetype="azure:monitor:aad:signin" earliest=-24h clientAppUsed IN ("Exchange ActiveSync","IMAP","MAPI","POP3","SMTP","Other clients","Authenticated SMTP","Legacy Authentication Clients") | stats count AS attempts, dc(userPrincipalName) AS unique_users, values(clientAppUsed) AS protocols, values(location.countryOrRegion) AS countries BY ipAddress | sort -attempts | head 10 | rename ipAddress AS "Source IP", attempts AS "Attempts", unique_users AS "Users Targeted", protocols AS "Protocols", countries AS "Countries"

table.title: Recent High-Risk Sign-ins (Last 24hr) — Requires Immediate Review

search.query: index="idsentinel_identity" sourcetype="azure:monitor:aad:signin" earliest=-24h riskLevelAggregated IN ("medium","high") | eval result_str = if('status.errorCode'=0, "SUCCESS", "FAILURE") | eval time_str = strftime(strptime(createdDateTime, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M UTC") | table time_str, userPrincipalName, ipAddress, location.city, location.countryOrRegion, appDisplayName, riskLevelAggregated, result_str, conditionalAccessStatus | sort -time_str | head 20 | rename time_str AS "Time", userPrincipalName AS "User", ipAddress AS "Source IP", location.city AS "City", location.countryOrRegion AS "Country", appDisplayName AS "Application", riskLevelAggregated AS "Risk Level", result_str AS "Result", conditionalAccessStatus AS "CA Status"
